title: Share the due-grant seeding between the store-busy host tests
outcome: Share the due-grant seeding between the store-busy host tests
acceptance: The due-grant seeding repeated in src/host/tests/store_busy/request_budget.rs and src/host/tests/store_busy.rs lives in one Fixture helper used by both tests, and both tests still assert the grant is due before the frame under test

The tests require begun_at, completed_at and open_grant_id to be present and null where the shipped wire serializes null, explicitly require open_grant_state to be absent when it is None, and describe seeding with an explicit historical UTC timestamp
disposal_reason: The target, due-grant test seeding, was physically removed with turn gating (landed at 5e8, cutover 6/6). Verified at master fe9a: due_grant and seed_due have no hits in src. Found by the legacy-scan explorer session-15943 at bad43423.
